title: fix(codex): detect new Codex threads in the archive corpus signature
context:
Reported by a user: new Codex sessions sat in "spawning" forever and then
vanished, and existing Codex sessions showed up only after a UI reload,
while Codex desktop listed all of them correctly.

_archive_corpus_signature_parts gated the Codex corpus on the store root
~/.codex/sessions. Codex nests rollouts by date
(~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-*.jsonl), so that root only changes at
year rollover -- measured 50 days stale locally. Creating a Codex session
left the signature byte-identic
decision: Changed server.py, tests/test_archive_signature_codex_rollouts.py: added _codex_rollout_day_dirs, CodexRolloutDayDirsTests, setUpClass, test_day_dirs_cover_today_and_yesterday, test_new_rollout_file_changes_the_corpus_signature, test_appending_to_an_existing_rollout_does_not_bust_the_cache, test_missing_day_dir_is_tolerated; new dep(s): importlib, time, unittest, pathlib, tempfile; 1 new file(s).
consequences: Adds dependency: importlib, time, unittest, pathlib, tempfile.
